lines.zh: 我一步步走过来，脚跟先落。
lines.en: I come step by step, heel first.
My pointed ears stir in the wind.

lines.zh: 短腿迈得很快，衣摆一直在晃。
lines.en: Short legs move fast; my hem keeps swaying.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想弄脏靴子。
lines.en: I go around stones; I will not dirty my boots.

lines.zh: 气从脚底冒出来，把土吹开。
lines.en: Ki leaks from my soles and blows the dust aside.
I am not quick, but I never stop.
My headwrap streams behind me.
I walk on the grass and it leans away.
I glance back now and then.

lines.zh: 这条路通向神殿，我认得。
lines.en: This road leads to the temple; I know it.
I open my fist, then close it.
My shadow draws more attention than my body.
I stand with my hands behind my back.
A small smile never leaves my mouth.
I am counting the time.

lines.zh: 这具身体不够大，但够用。
lines.en: This body is not large, but it will do.
Ki turns slowly inside me.
I squint at the sun.
The temple is still far.
I brush a speck off my hem.

lines.zh: 风把我的头巾吹得贴在脸上。
lines.en: Wind presses my headwrap to my face.
I push it aside.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被气烤得发黄。
lines.en: The grass under me yellows in my aura.
My knuckles crack.
I look up with a courteous smile.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不是本地人。
lines.en: Dressed like that, you are no local.
Your ki is weak, but interesting.
You need not be nervous.
Perhaps we can work together.
I say this while smiling.

lines.zh: 我侧头看你身后有没有人。
lines.en: I tilt my head to check behind you.
Have you come to stop me?
I step back, quite politely.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出来，掌心朝上。
lines.en: I extend my hand, palm up.

lines.zh: 你握了，我就记下你的力气。
lines.en: If you shake it, I learn your strength.
My smile deepens slightly.
Wind opens my coat.
I press it shut again.
I turn away as soon as I finish.
I grunt and give half a step.
I wipe the blood from my mouth.
My ki knots up around the wound.
This body is still too fragile.
I steady my feet.
Interesting.
This wound isn't even a warm-up.

lines.zh: 打我？指望我手下留情吗？
lines.en: Strike me? Do you expect mercy?

lines.zh: 这种小东西打动不了我。
lines.en: Such small things do not move me.
I glance at it and do not reach.
I push the food back to you.
I want something else.
This is not what I am after.

lines.zh: 你把它举得那么高，像在喂宠物。
lines.en: You hold it up as if feeding a pet.
I smile and do not take it.
My appetite lies elsewhere.
I turn and walk away.
You run into me and I hold firm.

lines.zh: 我侧肩让开，衣角扫到你。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and my hem brushes you.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的影子，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You step on my shadow; I dislike that.
I steady you with just enough force.
My ki pushes you back half a step.
We collide, and you give way.
I look down at you and smile.
Your hand touches my sleeve.
I pull my sleeve back.
The grass is trampled between us.
I have no interest in such things.
My goal lies at the temple.
Feelings are troublesome things.
I push it far away.
I smile, and it is cold.
This body does not need it either.
I look up at the sky.
What I want is not here.
I turn and keep walking.
I pinch it up between two fingers.
This is worth nothing.
But I keep it anyway.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I weigh it; it is light.
I set it down with a frown.
I can use this.
I wipe it clean and stow it.
I turn and go.
I raise my head and my smile fades.
So there you are.
My barrier stops your fist.
Ki rises from my soles to my shoulders.
Ki gathers in my palm. Don't blink.
First, let me see what you can do.
I lift one fingertip, and the ki begins to spin.
Small steps, but fast.
The ground grows hot with my aura.
I smile.
This time I will not be polite.
You move once, and I move.
I gather ki in my palm.
I circle you with light steps.
A ki blast forms between my fingers.
Can you block this?
I back off two steps and close again.
I press my ki that way.
The ground begins to crack.
You retreat; I chase.
My smile grows lighter.

lines.zh: 气焰把周围的草都点着了。
lines.en: My aura sets the surrounding grass alight.
At this range you cannot dodge.
I slip behind you and hold my ki still.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，气在掌心炸。
lines.en: I thrust my palm and ki bursts from it.
My toe snaps at the side of your knee.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往反方向拧。
lines.en: I catch your wrist and twist it back.
A short punch lands hardest.
A ki barrier bursts against your face.

lines.zh: 我连打两下，第二下更重。
lines.en: Two hits; the second is heavier.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，我从下面补一下。
lines.en: You block high; I come in low.
I drive my whole body into your chest.
A tap of my toe and I have changed position.
My palm wind peels your guard open.
I drive my elbow into your ribs.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我跟上三步。
lines.en: You fall back three steps; I take three.
Ki jets from my soles.
I stamp on your shadow.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
I land and lower my hands.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，先笑了一下。
lines.en: I step from the shadow, smiling first.
My ki arrives before my body.
This place makes a fine stage.
I straighten my sleeve.
The sky overhead is very blue.
I draw a deep breath.
No strong ones nearby; a pity.
I raise my hand and let my ki spread.
The grass bows beneath me.
I hear a bell far off.
That is the way to the temple.
I tighten my headwrap.
Now I have come.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣摆吹得笔直。
lines.en: Wind pulls my hem straight.
I take one step forward.
My shadow follows.
Let the show begin.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的衣袖，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从远处摔下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from a height and roll twice.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，帽子都飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me, headwrap flying.
A spell pins me in place.
My belly is empty and my ki weakens.

lines.zh: 雷落在头顶，我头发都立了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes above and my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我一直往下。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I keep going down.
